scoringUnit: Binary call/fault presence, micro-averaged overall. Multiple faults are separate events. Turn localization is not scored. Layer accuracy is conditional on matched fault ids.

bootstrap.method: Seeded percentile bootstrap resampling whole calls, preserving paired faults. Undefined replicate ratios are omitted. Precision n is predictions, recall n is injected faults, F1 n is union events, attribution n is matched events. Values withheld below n=20.

limits: Constructed transcript and timing fixtures only. Repeated template families are not independent production callers. No acoustic quality, real ASR, live latency or real fault prevalence is measured.
measures: Existing api/_naturalness.ts repetition and api/_voicebench.ts timing/trace budget checks; bench endpoint comparison. ASR mishear is NOT MEASURED because comparing generated heardText to generated truth is circular; ASR events are excluded from overall rates. Timing faults are measured on exact synthetic timings and are easier than real calls. Supported fault mappings: loop-repeat, talked-over-caller, false-endpoint, long-gap, early-hangup. Other fault recall is measured against no predictions; no semantic detector exists for those faults. api/_audio.ts probes need audio; api/_measure.ts and api/_suite.ts aggregate scores, not fault predictions.

asr-mishear.reason: Comparing generated heardText to generated truth is circular; no independent ASR recognition evidence exists.

signals.label: Questions per agent turn
signals.detail: Median 0 questions per turn; real agents sit at 0.6.
signals.because: One question per turn is a qualification rule, not a style rule — two questions is a form, and forms sound like forms.

signals.label: Sentences per agent turn
signals.detail: Median 2.0 sentences per turn; real agents sit at 1.2.
signals.because: Stacking is the single most reliable over-completeness tell.

signals.label: Type-token ratio
signals.detail: Call-wide type-token ratio 0.95; real agents sit at 0.75.
signals.because: People vary their words within a call. A model draws from a narrower set and the ear hears the narrowing.

signals.label: Turns containing AI-ese
signals.detail: 0% of turns contain a registered AI-ese term; the target is zero.
signals.because: These are register markers, not vocabulary. A real estate buyer hears "delighted" and stops listening.
